metaDescription: Order custom round headphones in bulk at Perfect Imprints. Great for branding with your logo. Get a quote today!
introHtml: Round headphones offer a classic, ergonomic fit that sits comfortably over the ears for extended wear. Whether you're equipping a call center with durable models like the TerraTone™ or providing branded sleep masks like the iLive™ Lights Out for employee wellness programs, the round shape ensures a secure, snug fit. Decorate with your logo using pad printing or embroidery for a professional look that stands out.
